title: Synthetic data generation
summary: A toolkit for generating and evaluating synthetic tabular data from Bayesian Networks, Copulas, CTGAN and CTABGAN models, tested on the PPMI and MIMIC-III healthcare datasets. It vendors and customizes the CTGAN source (Generator, Discriminator, DataTransformer) and calls SDV's evaluation API (evaluate_quality, get_column_plot, SingleTableMetadata) alongside direct Copulas (GaussianMultivariate, VineCopula) and SDMetrics reports to assess synthetic data fidelity.
evidence: src/modelling/ctgan/custom_ctgan.py:11-14 imports ctgan.data_transformer/data_sampler/synthesizers and redefines Generator/Discriminator; src/utils/sdv_utils.py:2-3 uses sdv.evaluation.single_table.evaluate_quality and SingleTableMetadata
